********************************************************************************
Ray version history
********************************************************************************

This table lists previous versions of the ROCm Ray Docker image for
installation and testing. For detailed information about available models, 
see the version-specific documentation. You can find tagged
previous releases of the ``ROCm/ray`` Docker image on `Docker Hub 
<https://hub.docker.com/r/rocm/ray/tags>`__.

   :header-rows: 1

   * - Release
     - Version
     - Components
     - Resources

     - `2.51.1 <https://github.com/ray-project/ray/releases/tag/ray-2.51.1>`__
     - 
       * ROCm 7.0.0
       * Ubuntu 22.04
       * PyTorch 2.9.0
       * Python 3.12.12

     - 
       * :doc:`Documentation <../ray-install>`
       * `Docker Hub <https://hub.docker.com/r/rocm/ray/tags?name=ray-2.51>`__
